overview_description.description: Clover is building the open, cloud-based point-of-sale platform. They partner with the world's largest payment processors, developers, and hardware manufacturers to bring point-of-sale products to market. They use Android as the client platform, which enables the use of inexpensive devices, both off-the-shelf and purpose-built.

about_short_description.short_description: Clover is a cloud-based open business operating system, powered by Android-based devices.

product.name: Clover POS System
product.description: A cloud-based point-of-sale system that processes payments and manages business operations across various industries.

product.name: Clover Payments
product.description: A payment processing service that accepts various payment methods including credit, debit, gift cards, and contactless payments.

product.name: Clover Software
product.description: Software tools for managing menus, orders, inventory, sales, and employees within the Clover POS ecosystem.

product.name: Clover Hardware Devices
product.description: Physical devices including countertop stations, handheld POS devices, scanners, card readers, and scales used to facilitate transactions and business operations.

product.name: Clover Apps
product.description: A selection of software applications that extend the functionality of the Clover POS system for tasks like online orders, reservations, loyalty programs, and customer management.

product.name: Clover Capital
product.description: A financing service that provides working capital to businesses by advancing funds based on future sales with flexible repayment tied to sales performance.
